exposure: presence of an ultrasonographic visible isthmocele
cohort: 150 patients with a history of cesarean delivery (75 with isthmocele and 75 controls) undergoing embryo transfer
finding: The presence of an isthmocele does not appear to significantly impact the chance of pregnancy in assisted reproductive treatment settings.
mod_finding: The study investigated the impact of isthmocele, a condition that can occur after cesarean delivery, on pregnancy rates in women undergoing embryo transfer.
